positioning_line: An alert fires. You get what broke, why, who's paged and the fix, with proof from your company's graph.
status_vocabulary: New: an alert arrived (webhook without respond=true) and no agent has run on it yet; open it to start them.
Investigating: Triage, Investigator and Comms are working; nothing for you to decide yet.
Cause found: a likely cause is named with a confidence; Confirm it or mark it Wrong.
Needs a human: the agents could not pick one cause; the suspects and the ruled-out list are still shown so you can pick.
Wrong cause: you rejected the named cause; pick the real one from the suspects or let the agents re-run with it excluded.
Confirmed: you confirmed the cause; the fix is saved to memory and the runbook is the next action.
Resolved: the alert cleared; the incident is closed, stays in memory and is searchable from Ask.

copy_rules: 'LLM chose X' is banned. Use the planner's own reason when present, else a per-tool default: open_incident 'so every agent works on one shared record', blast_radius 'to size the impact before paging anyone', page_on_call 'to get the owning team moving', recall_similar 'to check whether memory already knows this', hypothesize_from_memory 'to test the remembered fix before new suspects', correlate_alerts 'to see whether the alerts share a cause', suspect checks 'to test this change against the dependency path', write_update 'to tell the channel what we know'.

Tool titles in plain words with the id in mono beside: 'Who depends on checkout?' (blast_radius), 'Who is on call for checkout?' (page_on_call), 'Have we seen this before?' (recall_similar), 'Does the remembered fix apply?' (hypothesize_from_memory), 'Do these alerts share a cause?' (correlate_alerts), 'Test suspect: pricing-2140' (check_change), 'Draft the status update' (write_update); fall back to the tool id.
'Cypher: 4 querys' → 'Cypher · 4 queries · 5 rows · 13 ms' (pluralise with n === 1 ? 'query' : 'queries').

changes.change: Remove the stray 'null' text (guard h() against null children and keep .filter(Boolean) in renderProgress), fix 'querys' → 'queries', rename 'Fire'/'Fired' → 'Simulate'/'Simulated', 'Demo alerts' → 'Simulate an incident', 'Skip animation' → 'Skip to answer', 'Wrong cause?' → 'Wrong cause', and strip the 'svc:', 'chg:', 'inc:' prefixes with one short() helper used everywhere.
changes.why: These are the first things an engineer reads and every one of them says 'demo rig'; a 10-second credibility fix.

changes.change: Put the positioning line in the header tagline, rewrite the hero (H1 'What broke, why, who's paged, and the fix.', ≤25-word step cards, CTA 'Simulate an incident: checkout is slow' on solid #c2410c), drop the eyebrow, and render the landing synchronously from fixtures so the page no longer shifts when the API answers.
changes.why: Answers 'what is it, who is it for, what do I do' within 10 seconds and fixes the CTA contrast failure and the CLS 0.2 in one pass.

changes.change: Make the memory moment the headline: on a run where memory applied, render a full-width banner above the verdict ('Seen this before: INC-0912 checkout p99 above 2s, 3 days ago. Same fix.') with two large numbers '3 steps instead of 6' and '1 suspect instead of 4'; on act 1 show a one-line 'Seen this before: INC-0911… its fix didn't apply, so the search widened' under the verdict; after Confirm swap the Fix column to 'Saved to memory: next time …'.
changes.why: The cross-session memory is the demo climax and the Track 02 proof; today the numbers hide in a small card bottom-right.

changes.change: Derive a confidence chip from the suspect verdicts and show it beside the verdict: all-but-one ruled out → 'High confidence · 4 of 5 suspects ruled out'; ≥2 open → 'Medium confidence · 2 suspects still open'; none supported → 'Not sure · needs a human' and status 'Needs a human'. Show it only when a cause is named.
changes.why: The brief asks for confidence on the answer; a derived, explainable label beats a bare number and reuses data already in the trace.

changes.change: Restructure answer-main so the answer leads: verdict block (label, 22px cause line, byline with time-before-alert and source chips, confidence chip), 48px action row (Confirm cause / Wrong cause / Show me why →), three columns What broke · Who's paged · Fix, then 'Ruled out (n)' as one-line rows, then the path card, then the Slack preview collapsed to a one-line card with Preview. Right rail keeps 'What a change log alone would blame' and Sources.
changes.why: Today the root cause is a line inside a Slack message in a wall of text; the engineer at 3 AM needs cause, confidence, impact, who's paged and the two buttons without reading.

changes.change: Default the graph to the incident subgraph: in paint() remove (not dim) every element outside the run's touched elements plus one dependency hop, fit with 48px padding, set minZoom so labels never fall below 11px, add a 'Show whole company' toggle in the HUD, make the graph region a 3-row grid (HUD / canvas / legend) so the legend wraps and is never clipped, and show only legend kinds present.
